learning.title: Check nested workflow steps from the compiler's action sites, never from the flat step extractor
learning.trigger: Relaxing the flat workflow validator so branch, repeat, wait, sequence or parallel nodes validate, or adding any organization-scoped check (agent binding, capability policy) that reads a workflow's steps.
learning.mistake: validateWorkflowBindings read steps through extractFixedWorkflowSteps and returned no errors when it threw. That is harmless while the flat validator rejects nested nodes first, and fail-open the moment it stops: a nested model step whose agent allows no model capability would validate and publish with no binding check. The compile result cannot carry the fix, because WorkflowCompileResultSchema is strict and a contract test parses a real result against it.
learning.rule: For a document that declares apiVersion, take every action node from compileWorkflowDocumentDetailed (actionSites: qualified id, authored JSON Pointer, action, requires) and report findings at that pointer. A document that cannot be read yields no sites and the static pass reports it, so an empty list is only correct for an unreadable document. Keep compileWorkflowDocument's result unchanged; add sibling outputs instead of new keys.

verification.requirement: A nested model step under an agent that denies the model capability fails binding validation at /agents/<action> and at the step's own requires pointer; with the nested-site source removed that test fails.
